prompt: What is the valency of mercury in Mercury(I) chloride?
answer:
The valency (oxidation state) of mercury in **mercury(I) chloride, Hg₂Cl₂**, is **+1**.

The mercury(I) ion exists as the dimer **Hg₂²⁺**, so each mercury atom has a **+1 oxidation state**. Each chloride ion is **−1**, giving the neutral formula:

\[
\mathrm{Hg_2^{2+} + 2Cl^- \rightarrow Hg_2Cl_2}
\]
